reaction_lines.hospitalization_question: “Huh, I need to stay in the hospital? This is getting serious... How long will I be here?”
reaction_lines.hospitalization_response: “All right, I'll stay. But if there's anything I don't understand, I'm going to ask.”
reaction_lines.procedure_mismatch: “Wait, that isn't what you said earlier, is it? Doctor, just because I'm lying here doesn't mean I wasn't listening.”
reaction_lines.explain_plan: “Mm, that's much clearer now. Thank you for explaining it to me.”
reaction_lines.brief_plan: “Huh? That's all? Tell me a little more. I'm the one this is happening to.”
reaction_lines.last_reassure: “All right, I'll cooperate... But you have to keep talking to me, too.”
reaction_lines.choose_general: “Sleeping through it sounds pretty nice... But going to sleep without knowing anything is still a little scary.”
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: “My body will be numb, but my head will stay clear? Hmm... Then I'll hear everything you say.”
reaction_lines.choose_local: “Local anesthesia... If I tell you it hurts, you'll listen, right?”
reaction_lines.choose_none: “Huh? No anesthesia?! Doctor, I didn't come here for a pain-endurance contest.”
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: “Mm... I'm counting on you, then. This time I'm really putting myself in your hands.”
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: “No! I said I'd cooperate, not that I could stand being cut open without anesthesia!”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: “D-don't just tell me to hold still! It hurts so much my whole body wants to pull away...!”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: “Hold me steady... Even with the anesthetic, I'm still shaking from nerves.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: “My legs aren't really doing what I tell them anymore... You'd better hold me steady.”
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: “Ngh... Have you started? It doesn't hurt as much as I imagined, but knowing you're really operating is still so frightening...”
reaction_lines.incise_local: “Ah...! I can feel you moving... H-have you already started cutting?”
reaction_lines.incise_none: “Aaah!! It hurts! It really hurts! W-wait... I can't take it anymore...!”
reaction_lines.contact_pause: “Thank you... I almost couldn't bear it just then. Let me catch my breath...”
reaction_lines.contact_command: “All right, I'll stay still... But if I can't help crying out, you're not allowed to laugh at me.”
reaction_lines.contact_continue: “W-wait! You're just going to keep going? At least answer me...!”
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: “Mm, I'm listening. When you tell me what you're doing, I don't keep imagining things.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: “Ha... You're finally looking at me. I thought all you could see was the surgical field.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: “Doctor? Why has everyone suddenly gone quiet...? I'm still awake.”
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: “It's really almost over? Whew... I shouldn't have talked so tough earlier.”
reaction_lines.closure_coach: “Breathe slowly... All right, I'll follow your rhythm.”
reaction_lines.closure_silent: “It's almost done, right...? Tell me, Doctor... I'll worry.”

ward_enema: “Oh, an enema? That's part of the preparation, too... Wait, right now?”
“Mm, lie on my side... All right. I never thought being hospitalized would mean needing help even with this.”
ward_enema_unnecessary: “Huh? Isn't this step optional? Then why do it?”
“Doing it anyway when it isn't needed? Doctor, this isn't trying out a new menu.”
ward_skin_prep: “All right, I won't pull away... Wait, you have to shave that far down, too?!”
“Skin preparation, right... Huh? Here, too? How can you all act so matter-of-fact about it...?”
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: “You have to shave places that aren't being operated on, too? ...That's a little strange, isn't it?”
“Huh? Skin preparation outside the surgical area? Doctor, tell me why first.”
ward_surgical_cap: “All my hair goes inside? All right... I really look like a surgical patient now.”
“Hey, can you still recognize me like this? Don't mix me up with someone else!”
operative_positioning_awake: “My legs go here... Mm, I know I've had anesthetic, but I'm still awake.”
“Wait, don't suddenly turn me over. I'm awake; tell me first.”
operative_positioning_none: “You're securing me before giving any anesthesia? W-wait... What if it hurts so much I can't help moving?”
“I have to stay like this even after you start cutting...? Doctor, I suddenly don't feel like laughing at all...”
urinary_catheterization_awake: “A urinary catheter... Mm, I understand. But putting it in there... It's really rather embarrassing.”
“How can you all be so calm at a time like this...? All right, I'll try not to move.”
urinary_catheterization_none: “Ah...! W-wait... That's so uncomfortable! I'm completely awake...!”
“D-don't put it in without warning! Tell me first... I really will flinch if you startle me!”
skin_disinfection_awake: “Ooh, that's cold! So I can still feel the cold disinfectant even after the anesthetic.”
“You've disinfected all the way here... The scalpel is next, isn't it? Tell me before you start.”
skin_disinfection_none: “So cold... Wait, once the disinfecting is done, you're really going straight to cutting?”
“It's only disinfectant... But thinking of the cut that's coming next already has me trembling...”
incision_marking_awake: “Oh, this is the incision... Even with anesthesia, I can't help wanting to look.”
“Do you start once you've finished marking? I may still be smiling, but I'm really a little nervous.”
incision_marking_none: “You're really going to cut straight along this line? Without anesthesia... Are you serious...?”
“Don't make me keep staring at it... Thinking of the knife cutting along here scares me...”

reaction_lines.hospitalization_response: “All right, I'll stay. But Doctor, remember to use my name this time. I'm Aerith, not a number.”
reaction_lines.procedure_mismatch: “Wait! That isn't what we agreed on, is it? Doctor, this isn't Hojo's laboratory. You need to explain first.”
reaction_lines.last_reassure: “I know you're not Hojo... It's just that with so many white coats around me, sometimes I remember the past.”
reaction_lines.choose_none: “No anesthesia? Doctor, are you trying to treat me, or see how long I can stand it? I've seen plenty of that kind of research before.”
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: “Ah! Doctor, it really hurts! Don't just watch my reactions... I can talk! Listen to me...!”
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: “Doctor...? When you all suddenly go quiet, I remember my days in the laboratory. Could you say something to me...?”
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: “It's really over... Thank goodness. This time I'm not somebody's experimental result, just an ordinary patient, right?”

ward_enema_unnecessary: “Huh? You're doing it even though it isn't needed? Doctor, you're acting a little like a certain Shinra researcher... I don't miss him one bit.”
“An enema, too, just to observe a little more? ...I'm joking. But you'd better tell me the real reason.”
ward_surgical_cap: “Even my ribbon has to come off... All right. But don't just call me 'the patient' afterward. My name's Aerith.”
“Hiding all my hair... Mm, it feels a little like being at the research facility before. But this time it's just ordinary surgery, right?”
operative_positioning_none: “Wait... You're securing my arms, too? I know this is surgery... But hearing 'don't move' still makes me a little frightened.”
“Doctor, do you know what I hated most back then? Being positioned by someone who then just recorded my reactions... So at least talk to me, all right?”
urinary_catheterization_none: “W-wait! You're putting it in while I'm completely awake? At least tell me first... Don't just tell me 'don't move'!”
“Ah...! Doctor, I know this is necessary... But it's so uncomfortable... You can hear me talking, can't you?”
